changelog.name: CameraTools v1.3.1: Security Hardening, 15 Features & Modern Logo
changelog.body:
# CameraTools v1.3.1 — AOSP Preference Loading & LSPosed API 93 Fix (Pre-Release)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Hotfix Pre-Release for AOSP ROMs & Vector / LSPosed Users**:  
> In v1.3.0, users running AOSP ROMs (such as **Evolution X**, **crDroid**, and **LineageOS**) with **Vector** or modern **LSPosed** reported that preferences toggled in the UI were not applied to `com.android.camera` at runtime (`exists=false canRead=false` in diagnostic logs).  
> 
> **Version 1.3.1 completely resolves this with our new 4-Tier Bulletproof Preference Architecture.**

---

### 🚀 What's Changed in v1.3.1:

#### 1. LSPosed API 93 RemotePreferences (Non-Root & Root)
* Declared `xposedminversion="93"` and `xposedsharedprefs="true"` in `AndroidManifest.xml`.
* Module UI saves preferences via `Context.MODE_WORLD_READABLE`, redirected automatically by LSPosed API 93 into a shared cross-process IPC directory (`/data/misc/.../prefs/io.github.official_arvind.cameratools`).
* `HookMain` instantiates `new XSharedPreferences("io.github.official_arvind.cameratools", PrefProvider.PREFS_NAME)`, bypassing Android 14 filesystem DAC/MAC sandbox restrictions entirely.

#### 2. Automated SELinux Root Sync Bridge
* Added `syncPrefsWithRoot()` in `MainActivity`: dynamically discovers target camera package UID (`stat -c %u`), creates target directories, copies the XML config, sets `chmod 666`, applies `chown`, and runs `restorecon -F` to ensure full SELinux compliance.
* Guarantees that `/data/data/com.android.camera/shared_prefs/cameratools_prefs.xml` exists, is readable, and has matching SELinux contexts.

#### 3. Android 11+ Package Visibility Bypass
* Added `grantCameraUriPermissions()` in `MainActivity` to explicitly grant `FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION` across all 13 supported camera packages (`com.android.camera`, `com.miui.camera`, GCam packages, Aperture, GrapheneOS Camera, OpenCamera).

#### 4. Multi-Tier Fallback Provider
* Completely revamped `PrefProvider`'s `loadAllBooleans()` to traverse Device-Protected storage (DE), Credential-Protected storage (CE), and fallback XML directly, preventing default `false` returns.

#### 5. Live Lifecycle Preference Reloading
* Added hooks on `Application.onCreate` and `Activity.onResume` in `HookMain` to reload settings immediately when switching between CameraTools and the camera application without requiring a full zygote reboot.

---

### 📋 Instructions for Tester Jay & AOSP Users:

1. **Install Update**: Install `io.github.official_arvind.cameratools-v1.3.1.apk`.
2. **Grant Superuser**: Open **CameraTools** and tap **Grant** (Always Allow) when prompted by Magisk, KernelSU, or APatch.
3. **Verify LSPosed / Vector Scope**: In LSPosed/Vector manager, ensure **CameraTools** is enabled and `com.android.camera` (and your other camera apps) are checked in the scope.
4. **Configure & Restart**: Toggle your desired settings (e.g., 50MP RAW, 4K60, Bitrate) and tap **Restart Camera** inside the app.
5. **Verify Logs**:
   ```bash
   adb logcat -s CameraTools VectorLegacyBridge
   ```
   You should now see:
   ```
   [CameraTools] Successfully loaded preferences via LSPosed API 93 XSharedPreferences: raw=true, 50MP=true, 4k60=true
   ```
   or
   ```
   [CameraTools] Preferences updated via ContentProvider: raw=true, 50MP=true
   ```

---

### 📦 Checksums & Verification:
* **APK Filename**: `io.github.official_arvind.cameratools-v1.3.1.apk`
* **Version Code**: `131`
* **Version Name**: `1.3.1`
* **Min Xposed API**: `93`
* **Signature**: Android APK Signature Scheme v2 & v3 verified

changelog.name: v1.3.0 - AOSP ROM Compatibility Pre-Release
changelog.body:
## 🚀 CameraTools v1.3.0: Universal AOSP ROM & Framework Hooks Pre-Release

Welcome to **CameraTools v1.3.0**! This major milestone expands compatibility beyond stock MIUI/HyperOS to custom AOSP ROMs and alternative camera applications.

---

### 🔑 Important: Superuser (Root) Permissions Required
CameraTools requires and utilizes **Root Access (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch)**. When launching the app, please tap **Grant / Always Allow**:
* **Direct Sandbox Preference Sync**: Seamlessly syncs configuration XML files into the target camera application's private directory (`/data/data/com.android.camera/shared_prefs/`), bypassing Android 13/14 cross-package SELinux restrictions.
* **Instant One-Click Camera Restart**: Tapping *Restart Camera* runs `su -c am force-stop` on target camera packages so newly enabled features apply instantly without rebooting the phone.

---

### 🌟 What's New & Highlighted Features

#### 1. Universal Android Framework (`android.hardware.camera2` & `android.media`) Hooks
* CameraTools now hooks directly into Android Framework classes (`CameraCharacteristics`, `MediaRecorder`, `CamcorderProfile`, `PowerManager`).
* Enables features across **Xiaomi Camera**, **Google Camera (GCam)** ports, and **AOSP Camera apps**.

#### 2. Expanded Camera Ecosystem Support
* **Xiaomi Official & Ported MiuiCamera** (`com.android.camera`, `com.miui.camera` on HyperOS, MIUI, or ported to LineageOS/crDroid)
* **Google Camera (GCam) Ports** (BSG MGC, AGC, Shamim SGCAM, Snapcam)
* **Standard AOSP Cameras** (Aperture, Open Camera, AOSP Camera2)

#### 3. Core Feature Suite
* 🎥 **4K 60FPS Video Recording**: Smooth 4K recording at 60 FPS on the rear Sony IMX766 sensor.
* 🎬 **150 Mbps Cinematic Bitrate**: Studio broadcast-grade bitrate for pristine video capture.
* 🎞️ **50MP Full Bayer RAW Capture (DNG)**: True uncompressed 50MP RAW in Pro Mode.
* 🔴 **Leica Authentic & Vibrant Profiles**: Official Leica color tuning and Leica watermarks unlocked without region restrictions.
* 👥 **Dual-Camera Concurrent Stream (Director Mode 204)**: Simultaneous front and rear sensor capture with MediaTek PIP vendor tag support.
* ⏱️ **Extended Pro Exposure Range (60s – 1/16000s)**: Ultra-long 60s shutter for astrophotography down to 1/16000s for freezing action.
* ❄️ **Hardware Thermal Warning & Forced Shutdown Bypass**: Neutralizes thermal throttling so recording never stops due to device temperature.
* 🔍 **50MP Normal Photo Mode**: Seamless MediaTek ISP hardware remosaicing in standard Photo mode (strictly bound to rear Camera 0).

---

### 📢 Calling AOSP ROM Testers!
We invite users running custom AOSP ROMs (LineageOS, crDroid, Evolution X, PixelOS, DerpFest, RisingOS) on the Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G / Pro+ 5G (`ruby` / `rubypro`) to test this pre-release:

1. Enable **CameraTools** in LSPosed / Vector.
2. Ensure your camera app (e.g. `com.android.camera`, `org.lineageos.aperture`, or GCam) is added to the module **Scope**.
3. Launch CameraTools, grant root access, toggle desired features, and tap **Restart Camera**.
4. Capture logs if needed:
   ```bash
   adb logcat -s CameraTools VectorLegacyBridge
   ```
5. Share feedback and report any bugs on our [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/official-Arvind/CameraTools/issues)!

---

### 📦 Package Verification
* **File**: `io.github.official_arvind.cameratools-v1.3.0.apk`
* **Target Device**: Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G / Pro+ 5G / Discovery (`ruby` / `rubypro`, MT6877)
* **Minimum Android**: Android 13+ (API 33+)
* **Framework**: LSPosed / Vector (API 93+)
* **SHA-256**: `BE221BAC5EA49E4B980095532105678B3DEF36EE5F9AEFC75103CE5221532663`

changelog.name: CameraTools v1.1.0
changelog.body:
﻿## 🎬 CameraTools v1.1.0 Release Notes

### 🚀 What's New in v1.1.0:
- **Dual Video (Director Mode / Mode 204) UNLOCKED & FULLY WORKING**:
  - Unlocked simultaneous front (OV16A1Q) + rear (Sony IMX766) multi-camera concurrent streaming and recording on Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G (ruby / MediaTek Dimensity 1080 MT6877).
  - Bypassed HAL multi-camera restrictions (onValidateOpenLocked return bypass and max concurrent stream bump).
  - Fixed MediaTek session operating mode (rewriting vendor Qualcomm session types 0x9005 to standard Android SESSION_REGULAR).
  - Added hooks for DualVideoModuleUtil, ComponentRunningDualVideo, and Checker hardware bypass.
  - Cleaned up debug method tracing for optimal camera responsiveness.
- **Modernized Dashboard UI & Verified Package Structure**:
  - Full OLED-dark UI dashboard with per-feature colored pill badges, haptic feedback, and smart Enable/Disable All toggle.
  - Updated verified module ID to `io.github.official_arvind.cameratools`.

### 🌟 All Features Included:
1. **4K 60FPS Video Recording**: Unlocks true 3840x2160 @ 60 FPS recording with 60 FPS toggle switch.
2. **Cinematic Ultra Bitrate (150 Mbps)**: Boosts 4K video recording up to 150 Mbps HEVC for studio master quality.
3. **50MP Full Bayer RAW (DNG)**: Enables true 50-megapixel uncompressed RAW sensor capture in Pro Mode.
4. **Leica Authentic & Vibrant Profiles + Branded Watermark**: Injects official Leica color profiles and branding.
5. **Dual-Camera Concurrent Stream (Director Mode)**: Full concurrent front + rear recording.
6. **Extended Pro Exposure Range**: 60s long exposure astrophotography down to 1/16000s shutter.
7. **Complete Thermal Warning & Shutdown Bypass**: Prevents camera close dialogs or recording halts under high temperature.

**Package:** io.github.official_arvind.cameratools  
**Version Code:** 101  
**Version Name:** 1.1.0

Universal Camera Enhancement & Artificial Restriction Bypass for Xiaomi & AOSP
Engineered specifically for the Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G / Pro+ 5G / Discovery (ruby / rubypro) powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 1080 (MT6877V).

--- > [!IMPORTANT] > **Official Upstream Repository**: The source code, issue tracker, pull requests, and official releases for this module are developed and maintained at: > **👉 [https://github.com/official-Arvind/CameraTools](https://github.com/official-Arvind/CameraTools)** > > *This repository (Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.official_arvind.cameratools) serves as the distribution and catalog metadata entry for LSPosed / Xposed Module Repository indexing.* --- ## 🌟 Changelog & Release Notes For detailed release notes, bug fixes, and version history, please see **[CHANGELOG.md on GitHub](https://github.com/official-Arvind/CameraTools/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)**. --- ## 🔑 Root Permission (Superuser) — Why It Is Required > [!NOTE] > **Please Grant Superuser (Root) Access to CameraTools when prompted by Magisk, KernelSU, or APatch!** CameraTools uses root access for two critical operations: 1. **Direct Sandbox Preference Sync**: Modern Android (13 & 14) enforces strict SELinux isolation and cross-app private data access restrictions. CameraTools leverages root to copy your configuration directly into the camera application's private sandbox (`/data/data/com.android.camera/shared_prefs/cameratools_prefs.xml`) with world-readable permissions. This ensures 100% reliable preference delivery even when standard XSharedPreferences or IPC ContentProviders are blocked by the OS. 2. **Instant One-Click Camera Restart**: Tapping **"Restart Camera"** in the app uses root (`su -c am force-stop`) to cleanly terminate running camera daemon instances and restart the app, applying your new toggles in seconds without rebooting your phone. --- ## 📸 Supported Camera Applications & Environments CameraTools automatically detects your ROM environment (`RomDetector`) and injects the appropriate hooks depending on the active package: ### 1. Xiaomi Official & Ported MiuiCamera * **Package IDs**: `com.android.camera`, `com.miui.camera` * **Environments**: Stock MIUI 14, HyperOS 1.0/2.0, or ported MiuiCamera modules running on custom AOSP ROMs (LineageOS, crDroid, Evolution X, PixelOS, etc.). * **Experience**: Full integration including native Leica authentic/vibrant modes, 4K60 video toggles, 50MP normal photo remosaic, Pro Mode 60s shutter, and director mode dual-video. ### 2. Google Camera (GCam) Ports * **Package IDs**: `com.google.android.GoogleCamera`, `com.google.android.GoogleCameraEng`, `com.android.MGC`, `com.MGC` (BSG), `com.agc.cam` (AGC), `com.shamim.cam` (SGCAM), `org.codeaurora.snapcam`. * **Experience**: Unlocks 4K 60FPS target FPS ranges (`CONTROL_AE_AVAILABLE_TARGET_FPS_RANGES`), injects a true **150 Mbps bitrate** directly into GCam's `MediaFormat` / `MediaCodec` video pipeline, unlocks manual exposure parameters, and disables system thermal throttling interruptions. ### 3. Standard AOSP Camera2 / LineageOS Aperture / Open Camera * **Package IDs**: `com.android.camera2`, `org.lineageos.aperture`, `app.grapheneos.camera`, `net.sourceforge.opencamera`. * **Experience**: Framework-level interception via `CameraCharacteristics` and `MediaRecorder`. Directly exposes 60s exposure time range, 60fps video capture profiles, 150 Mbps recording bitrate, and bypasses thermal restrictions via `PowerManager.getCurrentThermalStatus`. --- ## ⚡ Comprehensive Feature Breakdown (15 Features) | Feature | Description | Architecture / Implementation | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **🎥 4K 60FPS Video (Rear & Front)** | Unlocks silky-smooth 4K (3840×2160) recording at 60 FPS on rear sensor and 4K (30/60 FPS) on the 16MP front camera. | Hooks `ComponentConfigVideoQuality.isSupport60FPS` and quality profile `2108` + `QUALITY_2160P` (8) across rear and front camera sensors. | | **🎬 150 Mbps Cinematic Bitrate** | Vastly elevates video recording fidelity from compressed stock ~30–50 Mbps to a broadcast-grade 150 Mbps stream. | In Xiaomi Camera, replaces compression tables with 150,000,000 bps. In GCam, overrides `MediaFormat` `bitrate` keys. In AOSP, hooks `MediaRecorder.setVideoEncodingBitRate`. | | **🎞️ Pro RAW (DNG) Native Bayer Capture** | Produces uncompressed, true 12.5MP native Bayer RAW (DNG) digital negatives in Pro Mode with full dynamic range for Lightroom/Photoshop. | Exposes native `RAW_SENSOR` (32) stream without overriding dimensions, ensuring rock-solid MediaTek HAL stream configuration. | | **🔴 Leica Profiles & Watermarks** | Unlocks authentic Leica Authentic & Vibrant color science profiles, custom Leica tuning, and genuine Leica watermarks. | Hooks `MiThemeCompatCV` and `ComponentConfigCvType` with strict reflection return-type safety guards. | | **👥 Dual-Camera Stream (Director Mode 204)** | Enables simultaneous video recording using both the rear main sensor and front selfie camera. | Activates hardware pipeline mode ID `204` with MediaTek Picture-in-Picture (MTK PIP) vendor tags and removes device blacklists. | | **⏱️ Extended Pro Shutter Range (60s – 1/16000s)** | Extends manual shutter speed up to 60 full seconds for astrophotography and long exposures, and down to 1/16000s for freezing fast action. | Hooks `ComponentManuallyDualLens` and framework `CameraCharacteristics.SENSOR_INFO_EXPOSURE_TIME_RANGE` (62,500ns – 60,000,000,000ns). | | **❄️ Hardware Thermal Bypass** | Prevents the camera app from throwing thermal popups, blocking 4K60, or forcibly terminating recording when the device heats up. | Neutralizes `ThermalDetector` and spoofer `PowerManager.getCurrentThermalStatus` to `THERMAL_STATUS_NONE (0)`. | | **🔍 50MP Normal Photo Mode** | Forces standard "Photo" mode to capture full 8192×6144 resolution with seamless MediaTek ISP hardware remosaicing. | Backend spoofing: Exposes ultra-pixel resolution while keeping normal UI, AE, and HDR controls intact. Strictly excluded from Portrait mode to prevent bokeh chroma corruption. | | **📹 Pro Video Flat LOG Profile** | Unlocks a flat LOG color profile in Pro Video mode for maximum dynamic range and cinematic LUT color grading in DaVinci Resolve or Premiere. | Unlocks `isSupportedVideoLogFormat` in camera configuration. | | **🎬 Cinematic MiMovie (2.39:1)** | Unlocks 2.39:1 anamorphic widescreen aspect ratio and movie framing guidelines. | Unlocks `isSupportedVideoMiMovie` and `isSupportedCinematicVideo`. | | **📝 Video Teleprompter** | Floating on-screen script prompter with adjustable font size, speed, and placement for effortless vlog presentation. | Activates `videoPrompterSupported` and `o0O0o0o` hooks. | | **🎯 Focus Peaking & Zebra Stripes** | Real-time edge focus highlighting and zebra stripes on overexposed highlight clipping regions. | Hooks `isSupportDepthFocusForMTK`, `o0O0ooOO`, and `isTeleX`. | | **👁️ AI Motion Tracking Focus** | Continuous AI tracking focus for human eyes, faces, and moving pets in photo and video. | Unlocks `isSupportTrackEye`, `isSupportTrackFocus`, and `isTrackFocusDefined`. | | **📄 Document Scanner Mode** | Automatic document and ID card scanner mode with perspective deskew, shadow removal, and contrast enhancement. | Unlocks `DocModuleEntry.support`, `o00o0oO0`, and injects mode `186` into `DataItemGlobal.getSortModes()`. | | **🎙️ Directional Audio Zoom & Bluetooth Mic** | Unlocks external Bluetooth earbud microphone audio recording and 3-mic directional audio focus. | Unlocks `isSupportBluetoothHeadsetMic`, `isSupport3MicEnable`, `isSupportAiAudioNew`, and `o00o0000`. | --- ## 📢 Calling AOSP ROM Testers! Are you running a custom AOSP ROM on your Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G / Pro+ 5G (`ruby` / `rubypro`)? **We want your feedback!** We have designed CameraTools specifically to support custom ROMs such as **LineageOS**, **crDroid**, **Evolution X**, **PixelOS**, **DerpFest**, and **RisingOS**. ### How to Test on AOSP: 1. **Install Module**: * Download and install the latest `v1.3.1` APK from [Releases](https://github.com/official-Arvind/CameraTools/releases). 2. **Grant Superuser (Root) Permissions**: * Open the **CameraTools** app. When prompted by Magisk, KernelSU, or APatch, tap **Grant** (Always Allow) so the app can sync settings directly to target camera data directories and execute quick camera restarts. 3. **Enable in LSPosed / Vector**: * Open your Xposed manager (LSPosed, Vector, etc.). * Enable the **CameraTools** module. * **Crucial Step — Verify Module Scope**: * For **Ported MiuiCamera**: Ensure `com.android.camera` or `com.miui.camera` is checked in the scope. * For **GCam**: Ensure your installed GCam package (e.g. `com.android.MGC`, `com.agc.cam`, `com.shamim.cam`) is checked. * For **AOSP Camera**: Ensure `org.lineageos.aperture`, `net.sourceforge.opencamera`, or `com.android.camera2` is checked. 4. **Configure Settings**: * Open the **CameraTools** app and toggle the features you want to test. * Tap **Restart Camera** inside the app. 5. **Capture & Submit Diagnostic Logs**: * Connect your phone to your PC via USB with USB Debugging enabled. * Launch your camera app and run the following command in terminal: ```bash adb logcat -s CameraTools VectorLegacyBridge ``` * If an app crashes, capture the crash stack trace: ```bash adb logcat -b crash ``` 6. **Submit Feedback**: * Open an issue on our [GitHub Issues Tracker](https://github.com/official-Arvind/CameraTools/issues) with: * Your ROM name & Android version (e.g., *crDroid 10.x, Android 14*). * Camera application tested & package version. * Output from `adb logcat -s CameraTools`. --- ## 🛠️ Installation & Setup Summary 1. **Prerequisites**: * Device: Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G / Pro+ 5G / Discovery (`ruby` / `rubypro`) * OS: Android 13 or Android 14 (Stock HyperOS / MIUI or AOSP Custom ROM) * Root: **Magisk**, **KernelSU**, or **APatch** (Superuser permissions granted to CameraTools) * Framework: **LSPosed (Zygisk)** or **Vector** installed and active 2. **Setup Steps**: * Install `io.github.official_arvind.cameratools-v1.3.1.apk`. * Open **CameraTools** and grant root permission. * Activate module in LSPosed / Vector and select camera app(s) in scope. * Reboot device or restart zygote. * Toggle desired camera enhancements and tap **Restart Camera**. --- ## ⚠️ Disclaimer & Safety * **Hardware Heat**: Bypassing thermal shutdown limits during extended 4K60 video recording or high ambient temperatures will cause the device to heat up. Use common sense and avoid leaving recording unattended in direct sunlight. * **Camera Sensor Support**: 50MP RAW and 50MP Normal Photo modes utilize the full sensor layout of the primary Sony IMX766. These modes are strictly bound to Camera ID 0 (rear main lens); the ultra-wide and front cameras will continue to operate at their respective native resolutions without crashing. --- ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the **GNU General Public License v3.0**.
